main.description: A world-altering action a Keepsake player broadcasts. Other players' clients subscribe to writes into this collection over com.atproto.sync.subscribeRepos and fold them into their own world state — see the design roadmap's shared-world phase in README.md. The acting player's identity comes from the commit's repo DID, not a field in the record.

detail.description: Optional flavor text other clients may surface as a rumor.
